title: 第13章 九铁玄鳇第14章 合成与刻纹
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
“族长！”
在族人们一声声的呼唤下，阿皓缓缓起身，他知道这是大伙对他的信任，也是对他的寄托。
岩蒙，连师都相信着自己能够带领部落过得更好，阿皓看向四周，单膝跪地的族人们，他们的眼中有些希望，同样也有着悲伤和苦涩。
在部落的传统里，每一位新的族长都会在盛大的仪式下，在所有族人的见证下新老交替。
现如今在场的只剩下最年轻的小辈，还有一伙族人没有任何消息。
阿皓同样也是单膝跪地，沉声道：“谢谢大伙的信任，我也不会辜负你们，相信我，以后的某一天，我会让你们闻名整个华古州，甚至整个大陆！
我要让世界都能被我等震动，”
在大伙的掌声中，众人站起身来。
只见邬童假装的一本正经的道：“族长！
那十六他们还没来，如今我们怎么办？”
阿皓白了他一眼，对着伙伴们道：“今天我先下我当族长后的第一个命令，你们不许叫我族长，还是按照以前的称呼吧。
你们不难受我还难受呢。”
“哈哈！”
邬童做着鬼脸，一把搂住阿皓笑道：“这不捧捧你吗。”
路北也上前笑着说道：“嘻嘻，我们也觉得叫阿皓哥顺口。”
一旁的洪生此时却紧锁眉头。
此时阿皓走到还在默默抽泣的万音，一向活泼开朗的她此时浑身污渍，一直得意的两个马尾辫也乱糟糟的，没有了往日的神气。
阿皓摸了摸万音的头，柔声道：“戈子叔会一直看着我们的，忘了之前说过的吗？只要我们在，岩牛的人就在，只要你万音在，戈子叔就会在。”
万音哇的一声哭了出来，投入阿皓的怀中，阿皓轻拍着这个此时无比脆弱的伙伴，沉声道：“这就是传承。
他们一直都在，所以我们要好好活着！”

没有热闹的宴会，没有丰盛的食物，就在简陋的草屋前，众人默默的进行完新族长仪式。
距离最后的约定之日还有两天，因为不知道那十六等会从那个方向来，只能叫邬童带着他的老虎先去附近寻找，看看能否找到一些踪迹。
又留下了路北和小四二人在原地待命。
自己则和其余伙伴明日清晨先一同去岩牛部落之前的据点。
从北部的圣塔山下来，西部是连绵不绝的十万大山。
南部就是禁地恶魔林，东方则是以圣塔山为源头一直向南流去的白峡江，白峡江再往东便是气势磅礴的悬崖峭壁。
白峡多以白色岩石组成，远远望去犹如被白雪覆盖一样，从白峡往下观瞧，只有那蜿蜒曲折的峭壁和深不见底沟壑。
“族长，我们要去的地方难道是那白峡？”
洪生认真的问道。
阿皓一听洪生的称呼，无语的拍了下自己额头。
洪生这人也是部落里年轻一辈中独特的一个，从小便做事一丝不苟，曾经邬童带着同伴们偷吃班如婶婶准备的年货，洪生制止后见没人听他的，转身就把邬童几人出卖了。
这让邬童几人边挨着打边说他像个老先生，洪生还奇怪的问道“这不是规矩吗？”
阿皓点头答道：“是的，我们要渡过白峡江，居所就在悬崖峭壁之上。”
此次阿皓的目的地就是白峡江对面的峡谷之中，安排完邬童等人，一行人一早便出发到达了白峡江。
为了避免水流湍急，大家沿着白峡江步行两个时辰。
这是白峡江的最上流，江水都是圣塔山山顶长年的积雪化成，清澈香甜。
连着对面的白色峡谷，如同到了人间仙境。
content_en:
"Clan leader!"
Ahao stood up slowly under the calls of the tribesmen. He knew that this was the trust and sustenance of everyone in him.
Yanmeng and even his master believed that he could lead the tribe to a better life. Ahao looked around at the tribesmen kneeling on one knee. There was some hope in their eyes, but also sadness and bitterness.
In the tradition of the tribe, every new leader will be replaced by the old and new in a grand ceremony witnessed by all the tribesmen.
Now only the youngest ones are present, and there is a group of clan members who have no news.
Ahao also knelt down on one knee and said in a deep voice: "Thank you for your trust, I will not let you down. Believe me, one day in the future, I will make you famous throughout Huagu Prefecture, and even the entire continent!
I want the world to be shocked by us,"
In the applause of everyone, everyone stood up.
I saw Wu Tong pretending to be serious and said: "Patriarch!
They haven't come yet, what should we do now? "
Ah Hao rolled his eyes at him and said to his companions: "Today I will give you my first order after becoming the leader of the clan. You are not allowed to call me the clan leader. Please use the previous title.
If you don’t feel uncomfortable, I still feel uncomfortable. "
"Haha!"
Wu Tong made a face, hugged Ah Hao and said with a smile, "Isn't this flattering you?"
Lu Bei also stepped forward and said with a smile: "Hehe, we also think it's easy to call him Brother Ahao."
Hong Sheng on the side frowned at this moment.
At this time, Ah Hao walked over to Wan Yin, who was still sobbing silently. She, who was always lively and cheerful, was now covered in stains, and her two ponytails that she had always been proud of were messy, and she lost her former air.
Ahao touched Wan Yin's head and said softly: "Uncle Ge Zi will always look at us. Have you forgotten what you said before? As long as we are here, the Yanniu people will be there. As long as you, Wan Yin, are here, Uncle Ge Zi will be there."
Wan Yin burst into tears and fell into Ah Hao's arms. Ah Hao patted his extremely fragile partner and said in a deep voice: "This is inheritance.
They are always here, so we must live well! "
There was no lively banquet, no sumptuous food, just in front of the simple thatched house, everyone silently completed the new clan leader's ceremony.
There were still two days before the final agreed date, and because he didn't know which direction the sixteen men would come from, he could only ask Wu Tong to take his tiger to search nearby to see if he could find any traces.
Lu Bei and Xiaosi were left on standby.
I and the rest of my companions will go to the Yanniu Tribe’s former stronghold tomorrow morning.
Coming down from the Shengta Mountain in the north, there are endless mountains of 100,000 in the west.
To the south is the Forbidden Demon Forest, and to the east is the Baixia River that flows southward from the Holy Tower Mountain. Further east of the Baixia River are majestic cliffs.
The White Gorge is mostly composed of white rocks. From a distance, it looks like it is covered in white snow. Looking down from the White Gorge, there are only winding cliffs and bottomless ravines.
"Clan leader, is the Baixia Gorge where we are going?"
Hong Sheng asked seriously.
When Ah Hao heard Hong Sheng's name, he patted his forehead speechlessly.
Hong Sheng is also a unique one among the younger generation in the tribe. He has been meticulous in doing things since he was a child. Once Wu Tong and his companions stole the New Year's goods prepared by Aunt Banru. After Hong Sheng stopped them and saw that no one listened to him, he turned around and betrayed Wu Tong and others.
This made Wu Tong and others say that he looked like an old man while beating him. Hong Sheng also asked strangely, "Isn't this a rule?"
Ahao nodded and replied: "Yes, we have to cross the Baixia River, and our residence is on the cliff."
This time Ahao's destination was the canyon opposite the Baixia River. After arranging for Wu Tong and others, the group set out early in the morning and arrived at the Baixia River.
In order to avoid the rapid water flow, everyone walked along the Baixia River for two hours.
This is the uppermost reaches of the Baixia River. The river reaches the top of Shengta Mountain.Years of snow melted into it, clear and sweet.
Connected to the white canyon on the opposite side, it feels like arriving in a fairyland on earth.
